title: Bagel Love Story
description:
The protagonist, Fan Tong, majored in law in college, but even after a year of graduation, he still couldn't find a job.
He wanted to work at his mentor's law firm, but was asked to lose weight and then cross-dress as a test?!
The weight loss journey was anything but smooth... Eventually, Fan Tong completely lost confidence.
Fortunately, an accident led him to meet a cute and sunny girl named [Bagel].
Thus begins a story of weight loss, cross-dressing, and romance!

• Celebrating the 10th anniversary of "Gaokao Love 100 Days," a special short game set in the same universe.

• A short Visual Novel with a runtime of 3-5 hours.

• Beautiful CGs and adorable chibi-style art.

• A light-hearted and heartwarming romance story.

• Includes the author's real-life weight loss experience!
description_short: A light-hearted and enjoyable short romance VN! The protagonist, Fan Tong, struggles to lose weight in hopes of finding a job, but the journey is far from smooth. Until one day, a cute and sunny girl named Bagel comes into his life, kickstarting a story of weight loss, cross-dressing, and romance!
